authorization: Execute the single remaining structured-merge feasibility branch for unresolved L5,p=.08 q=.5,.75 without increasing B.
question: Can a certified finite-state coarsening retain future charge information from all prefixes and tighten fair/intermediate LER bounds under at most 1024 observation states?
frozen_model: Same exact current transfer, elimination order, remaining-parity convolution, activity baseline and p=.08 as the completed branch-and-bound contracts.

merge.child_records: At each detector, distinguish the previous compressed label and new exact charge while forming frontier-sector weights.
merge.signature: Merge child records by last charge, current preferred-sector sign and a deterministic bin of absolute posterior log odds after exact remaining-parity convolution.
merge.certification: The label is a deterministic coarsening of public charge history. Bayes risk conditioned on the coarsened label is an upper bound on full-record LER; frontier and parity weights are otherwise propagated exactly.
merge.state_budget: Use 16,32,64 log-odds bins. With seven possible local charges and two signs this is at most 896 labels, below B=1024.

acceptance: Unmerged L3 reproduces exact LER; every merged L3 value remains an upper bound and all masses normalize.
Every study run uses at most 1024 observation labels and two million transfer states. Compare with activity and both prior priorities.
Promote only if certified activity-interval width falls by at least 10%. If neither cell passes, close the structured-merge branch at this registered resolution.
Preserve promoted q=.97,1 bounds; no threshold, fit, decoder or unregistered larger merge.
stop_rule: Stop after the frozen bin matrix or first state-cap failure. This is the only registered structured merge.
decision: Close the registered structured-merge branch. The finest 64-bin merge reduces fair-channel width by 8.11%, below the 10% gate, and gives no q=.75 improvement. No run hits the resource cap, so this is an evidentiary rejection rather than censoring.
next_action: Stop contraction micro-optimization. Consolidate the controlled partition-function explanation and benchmark its certified intervals against existing exact-oracle evidence, showing fair/intermediate p=.08+ as unresolved rather than fitting a curve.
